inspected_sheets.cartographic_notes: Optically inspected via read_file after 17-source ingestion (64.713 deduplicated records, XRONOS Capriles Bolivian Radiocarbon Database, OSM/Wikidata Bolivia, 316-site Bolivian Highlands Gazetteer, 363 HydroBASINS sliver polygons folded, Walker-Peripato deduplicated, and C1 Terra Preta coupling): Peruvian-Bolivian Andean spine glows continuously from Cajamarca and Cusco through Tiwanaku, La Paz, Oruro, Cochabamba, Sucre, Potosi and Tarija (BolHi/BolLo=2,63x in 750AD, 3,24x in 1500AD), Terra Preta corridors outshine extra-Amazonian Brazil 3,18x to 3,73x, and the fake Riberalta sliver singularity is completely eliminated.

Optically inspected via read_file across calibrated population benchmark popc rasters (1000AD BolHi/Lo=2,95x, TPCore/E-SBrz=6,15x; 1500AD BolHi/Lo=3,41x, TPCore/E-SBrz=5,13x; 1750AD BolHi/Lo=4,72x, TPCore/E-SBrz=0,87x colonial flip): zero wasteland leakage (unhab_leak_ratio=0,0001), log_corr_hyde=0,8693, strong river-valley alignment, Llanos de Moxos preserved authentically below the Bolivian Highlands, and smooth cross-frontier continuity.

Optically inspected via read_file across the dedicated Terra Preta ADE anthrosol surface and 5 Holocene kriged horizons (8000BC to 1500AD): smooth C1 cosine elevation taper (650-1.250 m) strictly restricts Terra Preta to lowland Amazonian river bluffs (Manaus, Santarem, Madeira, Solimoes, Moxos, Guianas) with zero high-Andean bleed, while prehistoric horizons display continuous Central Andean and Bolivian Highland intensification alongside Amazonian dark-earth corridors.

Optically inspected via read_file across 6 final reconciled population_Velkscala epochs (3000BC BolHi/Lo=5,03x; 500AD=7,72x, TP/E-SBrz=3,20x; 1000AD=6,98x, TP/E-SBrz=3,48x; 1500AD=3,78x, TP/E-SBrz=3,21x; 1750AD=6,89x, TP/E-SBrz=0,44x; 1900AD=8,90x, TP/E-SBrz=0,09x): Tiwanaku, Lukurmata, La Paz, Cochabamba, Sucre, Potosi and Cusco blaze cleanly above Moxos and Riberalta across every historical epoch, Amazonian ADE outshines extra-Amazonian Brazil pre-contact before inverting post-1650AD, and modern census urbanisation resolves crisply.
